item.title: [OpenWrt-RPi4] 3. Bringing up an SSD1306 in U-Boot on an OpenWrt image for the Raspberry Pi 4
item.description:
Goal

  • Bring up an SSD1306 OLED display over I2C in U-Boot running on the Raspberry Pi 4 (bcm2711).

Now that the Pi 4 boots with U-Boot (previous post ), our job is to add SSD1306 display support to it. We start from how the SSD1306 is brought up in the Linux kernel.
